purpose: Teach: 佑/ケイ/オイラ/毎度/意地/過ち/泡/お出かけ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 同じクラスの佑くん、引っ越したんだって。
lines.en: Our classmate Yu moved away, apparently.
lines.style: Casual, almost matter-of-fact delivery but with a thread of wistfulness underneath. Slight pause before the last word, like she's letting the fact settle. Soft exhale at the end.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: え、本当?ケイは、知ってるかな。
lines.en: Wait, really? I wonder if Kei knows.
lines.style: Genuine surprise lifting the opening word. Quick, attentive follow-up — the practicality of immediately thinking of his friend. No performance, just immediate concern.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: オイラはまだ聞いてないよ、って言ってた。
lines.en: He said he hasn't heard about it yet.
lines.style: Light, conversational relaying of information. Slight animation in the delivery — she's engaged in passing this along. Natural pacing, like she's sharing something that just happened.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 毎度、別れの季節は寂しいな。
lines.en: Every time someone leaves, it hits the same way.
lines.style: Quiet, philosophical. Not overdramatic, but genuine weight in the observation. Slow, measured pacing. He's not looking for agreement, just sitting with the feeling.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 意地を張らずに、連絡先交換しておけばよかった。
lines.en: I should've just swapped contacts instead of being stubborn about it.
lines.style: Soft self-recrimination. Quiet, introspective tone — she's turning the lens inward. No anger, just a small regret settling in. Trailing off slightly at the end.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 過ちは、これからの行動で取り戻せ。
lines.en: You can make up for mistakes with what you do next.
lines.style: Gentle wisdom delivered without preaching. Calm, steady conviction. A light undercurrent of wry affection — he knows she's being hard on herself. Steady eye-contact level.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 帰り、シェイクの泡、たくさん飲もう。
lines.en: Let's get milkshakes on the way back — lots of foam.
lines.style: Warmth returning to her voice. Brighter, more open delivery. The shift toward small restoration. Quick and light, like she's already feeling a little better. Genuine smile underneath.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 週末、皆でお出かけしよう。
lines.en: This weekend, let's all go out together.
lines.style: Soft closing warmth. Gentle invitation, not pushing but genuinely including. Steady and unhurried. The quiet certainty of friendship holding things together.
